_description: Training-set-size control: default-config FID-192 (10K samples, test split) of the AR generator retrained on random ChestMNIST subsets of 4,700, 20,000 and 78,468 training images (scripts/subsample_tokens.py --seed 0, scripts/run_data_scale.sh). Keys under 'seeds' are training-set sizes; mean and std are over sizes. The VQ-1024 row was evaluated on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 and the LFQ-1024 row on an NVIDIA L40S.
